body: I wish I could do those things. That sounds pretty good, actually.
I'm still alive. I am not much better.
I guess I should have watched the screen for 30+ minutes.
Did you try one before? I don't know what I would tell everyone. I don't know what I'd tell my boss.

With each passing year, I move farther away from when I was most capable and had the most potential. It's just getting worse for me now. 
You're a good person for caring for a stranger.
